title: Pbd Podcast Debate: Owens, Wilson clash over Kirk killing; proof of Israeli role still missing
summary_full: Candace Owens and Andrew Wilson debated claims about Charlie Kirk’s killing on the PBD Podcast. Wilson is a Christian conservative commentator known for The Crucible and Debate University. Owens did not prove that Israel was directly involved in Kirk’s killing. The debate drew more than 3.1 million views in under 24 hours, while the $500,000 payment remained unclear.
